subject: executor: Do not save long-lived unsafe.Pointer in hash join v2 (#54085)
summary: Replaces long-lived row address storage in HashJoin v2 (row table row starts, hash table buckets, probe matched-row headers) from `unsafe.Pointer` to rawData offsets and `uintptr` slots, materializing `unsafe.Pointer` only at point-of-use. Reviewed the updated build/probe/scan paths (including atomic bucket linking and next-row chaining) for correctness, concurrency, and SQL semantics; no remaining Blocker/High issues found in the executor changes at this commit relative to its first parent.
